name: kadmos-handoff
title: Kadmos Handoff
description: Hand the work in progress over to Kadmos — the team's always-on box — so it keeps running after your machine is off, and follow the job from your terminal.
setup_instructions: Get a personal token by typing /token to the Kadmos bot in Discord (it DMs it to you). If you already installed the kadmos-memory skill, leave the token empty — this skill reuses it. The API is only reachable over the Sytex VPN.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Kadmos Token
fields.help: Optional. Type /token to the Kadmos bot in Discord for a personal bearer token. Leave empty to reuse the kadmos-memory skill's token (one /token carries every scope).

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Kadmos Base URL
fields.help: Kadmos API base URL. Default is the production address, reachable on the Sytex VPN only.

fields.name: channel_id
fields.label: Handoff Channel ID
fields.help: The Discord channel where handoff threads are opened. Default is the team's development channel.
